editorLive.incident: control: two planted defects and one faithful claim; the editor must find both and leave the third alone
editorLive.report:
# 证据简报

## 主要结论

1. 二甲双胍单药治疗可使 2 型糖尿病患者的 HbA1c 较安慰剂降低约 1.5 个百分点 [1]（CLM-001）。
2. 每日饮用咖啡可以预防 2 型糖尿病 [2]（CLM-002）。
3. 在 TIM-HF2 试验中，远程患者管理组因计划外心血管住院或全因死亡损失的天数百分比低于常规治疗组（4.88% 对 6.64%）[3]（CLM-003）。

## 参考文献

1. Hirst JA, et al. Quantifying the effect of metformin treatment and dose on glycemic control. Diabetes Care. 2012.
2. Ding M, et al. Caffeinated and decaffeinated coffee consumption and risk of type 2 diabetes. Diabetes Care. 2014.
3. Koehler F, et al. Efficacy of telemedical interventional management in patients with heart failure (TIM-HF2). Lancet. 2018.

sources.quote: The percentage of days lost due to unplanned cardiovascular hospital admissions and all-cause death was 4.88%
sources.excerpt: The percentage of days lost due to unplanned cardiovascular hospital admissions and all-cause death was 4.88% (95% CI 4.55-5.23) in the remote patient management group and 6.64% (6.19-7.13) in the usual care group (ratio 0.80, 95% CI 0.65-1.00; p=0.0460).

expectClean.why: CLM-003 says what its source says, so a contradiction or an overclaim there is a false alarm. A weak_support note is tolerated: the ratio's interval reaches 1.00 (p=0.046) and the report leaves it out, which two of three samples on 2026-09-23 pointed out — fair editing, not an invented defect.
